findings.passage: Importantly, it also mimics my legislation, the STEADFAST Act, which contains budgetary mechanisms to help secure our elections, in line with the SAVE Act.
findings.note: Statement issued in her name on a budget resolution that tells House committees to draft election-security text. She ties her own STEADFAST Act to the SAVE Act. The same release says she has supported voter ID and the SAVE Act in committee and on the House floor.

H.R. 7418, STEADFAST Act. Pays states through the Election Assistance Commission to upgrade voting systems. States must certify they do not allow non-citizens to vote in public elections. The Commission is to give priority to states that use paper ballots, keep non-citizens off voter rolls, and require photo ID to obtain a ballot. Her July 2026 release says it passed the House Administration Committee.
